selection_methodology.previous_slice_boundary_rule: Slice 1 ends on 2025-05-05; Slice 2 begins with the next eligible frozen denominator alert-start date.
selection_methodology.start_rule: Start at the earliest frozen Zaporizhzhia denominator alert-start date after Slice 1 that is not already assigned to Slice 0 calibration.
selection_methodology.stop_rule: Add complete chronological Europe/Kyiv alert-start dates until the unique episode count first reaches at least 170 without exceeding 200.
selection_methodology.eligibility_rule: Exclude any episode already present in Slice 0 or Slice 1; preserve complete alert-start dates among eligible episodes.
